pick.title: PhRMA sues over Trump policy mandating lower drug prices in Medicare
pick.headline: Drug Industry Sues to Preserve America's Exclusive Right to Overpay for Medications
pick.take: The industry's main trade group is suing over a pilot that ties Medicare prices to what peer countries pay. Those countries have been paying these prices for years and, remarkably, still have medicines. Apparently the American price is a delicate ecosystem that cannot survive comparison.
